findings.title: gallery_arm still quietly captures with the BASELINE font on a failed candidate load - contradicting the body's 'The gallery's quiet-fallback lie is impossible now'
findings.evidence: gallery_arm: f := rl.LoadFontEx(...); if rl.IsFontValid(f) {...swap...} else { fmt.eprintfln("gallery: cannot load %s — capturing with the baseline font", path) } - then proceeds to write frames under the candidate's tag; body: 'The gallery's quiet-fallback lie is impossible now.'

findings.recommended_fix: Exit non-zero on candidate-load failure in gallery_arm (mirror font_check), or tag the captures 'baseline' so artifacts cannot misrepresent the family.
